name: Kanto in Motion
description: Kanto in Motion multi-generation HD Pokemon presentation and battle overhaul. Supports Red/Blue/Yellow, Gold/Silver/Crystal, and FireRed/LeafGreen/Emerald; v1.6.5 adds cooperative 1025Dex battle-sprite routing with KIM grounding/shadows, improves Gen 2 mobile scroll-arrow spacing, and hides the Game3 KIM ASSETS Start Menu entry when the shared HD cache is healthy.
